title: Glam Speakeasy, Free Parking, Photo Booth
description:
Step inside your Glamorous Speakeasy! Inspired by the iconic women of country music, this moody retreat sleeps 6 and blends modern comfort with sophisticated flair. Get ready in your chic glam room, capture memories in your private photo booth, take a dip in the resort-style pool, and relax in the sky lounge. Enjoy a full gym and secure, hassle-free parking, included for your stay. Just minutes from Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, and the Convention Center, your Music City adventure starts here!

The space
🎸 Your Glamorous Speakeasy sits in the heart of SoBro, surrounded by Nashville’s best honky‑tonks, restaurants, and local hotspots. Enjoy true downtown convenience while retreating to your private hideaway, just 0.4 miles from the Country Music Hall of Fame and Music City Center, and 0.6 miles from Broadway and Bridgestone Arena.

Inside Your Glam Speakeasy:

✦ Comfort & Convenience
𐚁 Taylor’s Suite: King bed with refined, hotel-style comfort
𐚁 Carrie’s Glam Room: Two full beds with luxe finishes
𐚁 Sleep Comfort: Highly rated mattresses & hotel-quality linens
𐚁 The Opry Lounge: Queen sofa bed with real mattress
𐚁 Glam Station: Get concert-ready for Broadway nights
𐚁 Dedicated Workspace: Fast Wi-Fi for work or plotting your Nashville days
𐚁 Kitchen: Fully equipped with cooking essentials
𐚁 In-Unit Washer & Dryer: Easy laundry during your stay
𐚁 Getting Ready: Iron, steamer, hair dryer & full-length mirror
𐚁 Coffee Corner: Keurig + French press for your perfect brew
𐚁 Secure Building & Parking: Covered, free, downtown

✦ Entertainment & Vibes
𐚁 Photo Booth: Channel your inner country star
𐚁 Private Stage: Sing your heart out to your favorite country hits
𐚁 Record Player: Spin vinyl and set the mood
𐚁 Projector Screen: Movie-night magic

✦ Elevated Amenities
𐚁 Resort-Style Pool: Cool off before your Broadway nights
𐚁 Fitness Center: 24/7 gym with yoga & cycling studios
𐚁 Sky Lounge: Fire pits, BBQs & city skyline views
𐚁 Balcony: Morning coffee or nightcap views
𐚁 On-Site Dining & Treats: Japanese restaurant Kosho and ice cream parlor Tipsy Scoop

Guest access
🔑 Guests have full access to the apartment and shared amenities, including the pool, sky lounge and 24/7 fitness center.

Other things to note
🅿️ One free parking spot is reserved for you. Accessible spots are limited and available for a small fee, please reach out early if needed. Self check-in is easy and contact-free through secure lobby lockers.
